notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 4x each count). Categories group temas 1 to 23 of the official temario (Resolución de 3 de octubre de 2022, updated 29 de mayo de 2023); temas 24 (inglés) and 25 (lengua española) are separate tests and not modelled. The 6/6/4/8/6/6/6/4/4 split is Tigertest's (no official weights). Five topic sets 22401-22405 + 4 tests = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 63 (32 of 50) = the real 50-point minimum when every question is answered under the A - E/3 penalty, which Tigertest does not apply.
